about_the_game:
Slightly terrifying and suspenseful Welcome to this visual novel game.

At the moment I opened my eyes, I found myself in a dark water tank, with cold water pouring in mercilessly, compressing the remaining breathing space. I struggled to breathe, trying to find a way to survive, but to no avail.

No... save me

Memories drift with the flow, sinking into the depths of the water after endless confusion and uncertainty.

I, Mo Lan, a new student at the World College. He was betrayed by his classmates while completing the entrance exam, and was sentenced to the death penalty of drowning and suffocation in cold water if he failed the exam.

I remembered many forgotten memories - the girl pretending to be strong in the confinement room, the farewell from him under the starry sky in the forest, and the affectionate embrace in the sea of fire .....

In the end, I arrived at a vast space and met the mysterious reincarnation person. He told me that I and other students were trapped in a school called "Li World College" and forced to become its students, enduring great torment Only by graduating from this school can one escape ..

The college is cursed by the cycle of time. After each death, I will return to the day of the admission ceremony, forget all my past memories, and return to the starting point of time with a new identity, and enroll again.

So... everything is just a cycle

I want to restart the cycle, save the bullied classmates, and uncover the dark truth behind the scenes Break the curse of reincarnation!

I will definitely find a way to escape from this terrifying hell... At that time, I will retrieve my lost memories, come back here again, and ask you clearly

I once again lost my memory and returned to that despairing and cold classroom.

In the dark and eerie horror academy, teachers who are monsters will regularly release impossible exam tasks, and students who fail the exam will be brutally executed.

Campus bullying? Trade in power and color? The academy is filled with dark transactions that cannot be seen in the light.

Friendship? Admire? Four characters will engage in intense and thrilling survival with you.

You will lead yourself into the situation, completely breaking through all darkness, and the true light will be welcomed by your own hands.

The United Nations report points out that 246 million children worldwide suffer from school bullying every year.

When encountering bullying, please raise your fists and boldly resist, only resistance can end the violence!

May world peace be without tears.

content_descriptors.notes: Horror pictures and images can be blocked in the game settings.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 7/8.1/10/11
  • Processor: Pentium 4
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: VRAM 64MB, 1280×960
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 7/8.1/10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: VRAM 64MB, 1280×960
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: This is a short, slightly terrifying, suspenseful and bizarre visual novel game. Players will take on the role of student Mo Lan, who loses all memories and joins a school of social monsters to rescue bullied classmates and uncover the truth behind campus bullying.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
